description: Non-exhaustive golden examples only. Determine later-phase applicability and dependencies from Discovery evidence and user scope; propose additional phases when findings justify them. Do not treat example ordering as a required sequence or demand implementation proof before proposing scoped work. Native and mapped content examples are mutually exclusive implementations of one content-transfer phase per scope.

notApplicableWhen: Adopted-target reconciliation proves all included code work equivalent and no validation-only deliverable is requested
taskPatterns: one task per included Sitecore rendering for high-risk or independently verifiable units
feature or route batches of renderings with their supporting React modules
separate shared style/layout/framework milestones where dependencies justify them

mandatory preview-foundation readiness task for every rendering scope, for new and adopted apps; make rendering tasks depend on it; conditionally prepare mock-layout-scaffold → shared-styles-shell → preview-foundation for Headless/JSS targets needing disconnected preview, reusing equivalent mock/style foundations without omitting readiness
tasks: Prepare approved code inventory and mappings

Convert approved component batches and shared concerns after their applicable prerequisite evidence is current
Validate route-level rendered output
Independently audit per-rendering coverage, current evidence and user attestations

Build/static validation output
Representative route render comparison with unresolved gaps
Tester reconciliation of every included rendering against its approved task mapping, evidence and separate user attestation

site-section batches
